items.title: Finiteness and torsion freeness of the limit of the global sections of an inverse system of sheaves over a complete principal ideal ring
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a Noetherian ring A complete with respect to a principal ideal (f), an inverse system of sheaves whose first term has finite global sections and which satisfies the f-divisibility condition has M = lim Gamma(X, F_n) finite over A with f a nonzerodivisor and M/fM the image of M in Gamma(X, F_1). The proof derives the containment M/fM inside H^0(X, F_1) from a cited result, gets finiteness of M/fM from that containment, observes that the intersection of the f^nM is zero by construction, and concludes finiteness of M from the cited complete-ring criterion (proof lines 9316-9322). The final claim is a one-line kernel computation: if fs = 0 then s_{n+1} lies in the kernel of F_{n+1} -> F_n by the divisibility condition (proof lines 9323-9328). H2: combining the two cited finiteness criteria with the explicit description of the kernel is the substance.
